refuted.finding: The search box placeholder reads "Search or type @ to filter", while the approved artboard's search-input draws "Search packages, or filter: @installed, @updates, @vulnerable". The capture's copy differs from the artboard and no longer names the available filters.
refuted.reason: The crop does show "Search or type @ to filter" where the artboard draws "Search packages, or filter: @installed, ...", but this copy is the declared design: design-system.md's main-header overflow row names it as the main search box's placeholder (the side bar's hint, since UX-P3.fix-15, DECISIONS 2026-11-16, with the Filter button carrying the filter names). The hard measurement agrees: "DS-OVERFLOW-2@main-installed-all/placeholder: placeholder \"Search or type @ to filter\" 164 of 1136 px (hard)". So the round-3 artboard text is stale, not a product defect.
